name: DuckDB Archive Error Plan

userStories.title: Reduce peak memory usage in archive refresh
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the archive refresh path to use smaller commit scopes so that DuckDB no longer runs out of memory during commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduce transaction or commit size in the archive refresh path before relying only on a higher memory limit
Evaluate smaller committed units, narrower rewrite scope, or lower working-set size for the archive rebuild or purge flow
If DuckDB session tuning is needed, apply only the minimal targeted settings required for the archive refresh path
The updated path no longer reproduces the commit-memory failure in the focused repro flow
Relevant targeted `bun test` commands for touched archive-refresh files pass
Relevant `bunx eslint` command for touched files passes
userStories.notes: Reworked archived serving purge to rewrite through a replacement table using explicit-column batch inserts and separate index rebuild, reducing commit scope and avoiding the prior memory-pressure path.

userStories.title: Harden cleanup after commit failure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want commit-time failures to report the real memory problem cleanly so that the logs are actionable and retries behave predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not attempt `ROLLBACK` when no transaction is active after a commit-time failure
Preserve the original `Failed to commit: failed to pin block` error as the primary reported failure
Avoid misleading chained failures dominated by `cannot rollback - no transaction is active`

Relevant `bunx eslint` command for touched files passes
userStories.notes: Commit-time errors now skip misleading rollback attempts when no transaction is active, preserving the real failure instead of chaining `cannot rollback` noise.
